summary: W4 audit passed. The recipe uses the official Swift 6.3.3 source tag with a verified SHA-256, builds the upstream C runtime through CMake, exports the expected CMake target, and provides a real -fblocks consumer test covering Block copy, invocation, and release. No deceptive, empty, or fabricated test behavior was found.
